input_table.title: Input Table Name
input_table.description: Name of the Keboola Storage input table (without .csv extension). The first CSV column is the row member; remaining columns are dense dimension members (e.g. time periods).

context_members.title: Context Members
context_members.description: Default members for BSO dimensions not represented as columns in the input table (e.g. ["East", "Actual", "Sales"]). Order matches the Essbase outline.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of rows to send per API call (default: 1000).
